description: This Java source file defines the 'RetrieveThingDefinition' class, a command that retrieves the definition of a 'Thing' based on its ID within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, manages command metadata, and provides implementations for JSON serialization and equality checks.

classes.name: RetrieveThingDefinition
classes.description: A command class that retrieves the definition of a specific 'Thing' in the Eclipse Ditto framework based on its ID. It contains methods for creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and metadata about the command.
